one_month_reasoning: No IREN earnings in the window: Q1 FY27 results are expected in early-to-mid November (last year early November), so outside Oct 31. In-window events: possible announcements on Microsoft Horizon 2-4 phase deliveries (targeted calendar Q4 2026, grace to Q2 2027) and new 2027 contracts (mgmt says late-stage talks) - modest upside skew if announced, but the market has stopped paying for contract headlines (Yahoo, Sep 2026); hyperscaler earnings (Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon ~Oct 27-30) with capex/lease commentary that moves neoclouds as a group; FOMC late October with 10y at a multiyear-high 5.29%. Stock is in a 12-month downtrend (-47% from high, negative momentum) offset by oversold-reversal potential. Net: near-symmetric lognormal around ~$40.4 (tiny negative drift for momentum/dilution via ATM) with monthly sigma ~0.30 (107%/3.5), slightly fat tails.

fair_value.method: 50/50 blend of a DCF ($29: WACC 11.5%, 72% steady EBITDA margin, $27bn FY27 capex, ~$14bn revenue by FY29, g 3%) and EV/NTM EBITDA at Oct-2027 ($48: $6.5bn x 7x less ~$16bn net debt, 620m shares) = $38.5.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Unlevered FCFF, FY(Sep) 2027-2032: revenue $4.4/11.0/14.0/14.0/13.5/13.5bn; EBITDA margin 60%->68%->72% steady (71% late); capex $27/6/2/3/4.5/4.5bn; D&A $2.5-5.8bn; tax 21%; WACC 11.5% (Ke 15.3% = 5.29% rf + 2.0 beta x 5% ERP; after-tax Kd 6.3%; 55/45 E/D); terminal g 3% with reinvestment g/ROIC (ROIC 15%); EV $10.5bn, net debt ~0 at 6/30/26, 420m diluted shares -> $25.1 today, rolled forward 12m at Ke -> $29. Sensitivity: WACC 10% -> $46, 13% -> $17; steady margin 65% -> $15, 78% -> $44.

Midpoint of FY27 capex guidance $25-30bn (includes Microsoft delivery, 2026 contracted deployments, early 2028 work).
~800MW x ~$29m/MW GPU cost / ~5.5y life (IREN uses 5y HPC life) plus DC sustaining; FY28 $6bn completes 2027 builds.
GPU base ~$23bn over 5y plus ~$8bn DC over 20y; FY26 D&A was $417.7m before new capacity.
Implied from 107% realized vol x ~0.3 correlation / ~16% market vol; consistent with neocloud credit stress (CoreWeave CDS 855bp).
GPU financings at 6.0% (investment-grade, Microsoft) and 9.0% (non-IG, Blue Owl/PIMCO); converts ~1% coupon but equity-linked; 8% blended marginal.
0.55 x 15.3% + 0.45 x 6.3% = 11.3%, rounded up for execution risk.
Industry still growing (CoreWeave $104bn backlog, Nebius 5GW contracted power) but GPU-rental returns compress over time; ROIC set modestly above WACC.
394.06m ordinary shares at Aug 14 2026 plus ~26m RSUs/options outstanding at 6/30/26; converts treated as debt (Dec-2033 notes convert at $73.07).
Total debt $7.59bn vs cash $5.90bn + restricted $1.72bn; future funding gap is captured as negative FCFF.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: Oct-2027 NTM EBITDA $6.5bn x 7.0x = EV $45.5bn; less projected net debt ~$16bn (FY27 funding gap ~2/3 debt/prepayments); /620m shares (420m + ~200m issued via ATM for ~1/3 of the gap at ~$40) = $47.6 (all-debt funding gives ~$51).

inputs_detail.derivation: DCF FY28 EBITDA $7.5bn (revenue $11bn x 68%) haircut ~13% for 2027 delivery delays (Microsoft grace periods run to Q2 2027).

Peer NTM multiples: CoreWeave ~10x, Nebius ~20x, IREN ~20x (Dealroom). 7x discount to CoreWeave for 2027 capacity not yet built/contracted, 5.29% 10y yield, and sector credit stress (CoreWeave ~50% implied 5y default odds).

inputs_detail.input: Funding gap / net debt at Oct 2027

bear.story: Horizons 2-4 slip into 2027, 2027 capacity under-contracted or priced below $20m/MW as hyperscalers self-build and GPU rental prices for aging Hopper/Blackwell fall; funding gap filled by heavy ATM issuance at low prices; neocloud credit stress (CoreWeave CDS) spreads; sector multiple compresses to ~5x EBITDA.

base.story: $4bn ARR live by early 2027, ~500MW of 2027 capacity contracted near $20m/MW and partly in service; EBITDA run-rate approaches $6-7bn but dilution (~+40-50% shares) and high rates cap the multiple at ~7x; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: On-time delivery, 2027 capacity sold at ~$25m/MW to diversified frontier/enterprise customers, financing mostly asset-backed debt (little ATM), Nvidia/hyperscaler demand stays strong (B200 rental prices rising); re-rate to 10-12x NTM EBITDA toward CoreWeave/Nebius.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$24 (equity ~$10bn, EV ~ 2.5x contracted 2026 ARR) the market would be pricing a funding failure or contract problem rather than volatility: e.g. Microsoft Horizon delivery missed beyond grace periods, a large customer default/renegotiation, inability to finance 2027 GPU capex without deeply dilutive equity, or a collapse in GPU rental pricing.

key_uncertainties: Delivery timing of Horizons 2-4 and 2027 capacity (supply chain for NVIDIA equipment already delayed Horizon 1)
Funding mix for $25-30bn FY27 capex: asset-backed debt vs ATM dilution
Durability of $20-25m/MW pricing as hyperscalers self-build and GPUs age; residual value after 3-5y contracts
Neocloud credit conditions (CoreWeave CDS ~855bp in July) and 10y yield at 5.29%
Customer concentration (Microsoft $9.7bn) and creditworthiness of AI-lab customers
DCF is extremely sensitive to WACC and steady-state margin ($15-$46 across reasonable ranges)
reasoning: Industry read-through is strong on demand and pricing: Nvidia DC revenue +117% y/y with a $108bn next-quarter guide; CoreWeave backlog $104bn (+$25bn more early Q3) and raised capex; Nebius ARR guide $7-9bn with deal yields >$20m/MW and <2y payback, matching IREN's >$20m/MW (talks at ~$25m/MW); Microsoft's neocloud commitments >$60bn; B200 rental prices up ~79% in 3 months while H100 drifts lower (aging-hardware repricing risk). Against that: neocloud credit stress (CoreWeave CDS ~855bp, ~50% implied 5y default), a 5.29% 10y yield, hyperscaler self-build risk, Texas SB 6 interconnection batching, and IREN's own funding gap (FY27 capex $25-30bn vs $14bn cash/committed funding, share count +52.7% in 14 months). Valuation: a DCF with sourced inputs gives ~$29 12m forward (very WACC/margin sensitive); an EV/NTM EBITDA approach at 7x (discount to CoreWeave ~10x) gives ~$48; blended fair value $38.5, slightly below the $40.65 close. Scenarios bear $16 (30%) / base $40 (45%) / bull $75 (25%), mean ~$42. Ladder is a lognormal with median ~$37-38 and sigma ~0.78 (below the 107% realized vol because the business is now contracted-revenue heavy, but still very wide), trimmed in the far right tail; Polymarket puts only 8% on an AI 'bubble burst' by Dec-2026 and 17.5% by Jun-2027, consistent with my 30% bear weight that includes IREN-specific execution/dilution. Option-implied data was not consulted. Twelve Data statistics/targets and Alpha Vantage were unavailable (plan/rate limits); research used web search/fetch and SEC filings.
